gloss: to feel ashamed; to be embarrassed

definitions.gloss: to feel ashamed; to be embarrassed; to feel disgrace
definitions.explanation: To feel shame about one's own actions, behavior, or shortcomings. A more introspective and literary word than 恥ずかしい.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{無知|むち}→無知：18641_muchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{恥|は}じた。
examples.english: I felt ashamed of my own ignorance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{過去|かこ}→過去：00152_kako⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{恥|は}じること⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: There's no need to be ashamed of past mistakes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先輩|せんぱい}→先輩：01451_senpai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{恥|は}じるような⟦{振|ふ}る{舞|ま}い→振る舞い：10520_furumai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧しまった。
examples.english: I behaved in a way I was ashamed of in front of my senior.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
Ichidan verb ({一段動詞|いちだんどうし}), intransitive. Takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ to mark what one is ashamed of: ～⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{恥|は}じる.

USAGE:
More formal and reflective than ⟦{恥|は}ずかしい→恥ずかしい：00843_hazukashii⟧. Used when someone feels genuine shame about their own conduct or character, not simply situational embarrassment.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{恥|は}じる (to be ashamed of oneself)
- ⟦{無知|むち}→無知：18641_muchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{恥|は}じる (to be ashamed of one's ignorance)
- {恥|は}じること⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧ (without shame; shamelessly)
- {恥|は}じ{入|い}る (to be deeply ashamed)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{恥|は}ずかしい→恥ずかしい：00843_hazukashii⟧: embarrassing; embarrassed — covers both situational embarrassment and shame, much more common in daily conversation
- {恥|は}じ{入|い}る: to be deeply ashamed — stronger, more literary form
